# اُعْتُلِيَا (uʕtuliyā) /uʕ.tu.li.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# اِعْتَلِيَا (iʕtaliyā) /iʕ.ta.li.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
